<?php
$conn = mysqli_connect("localhost", "root", "", "BD123456");

$mail = $_POST["mail"];
$mdp = $_POST["mdp"];
$genre = $_POST["genre"];

$q1 = $_POST["q1"];
$q2 = $_POST["q2"];
$q3 = $_POST["q3"];


$rS = mysqli_query($conn, "SELECT NumS FROM Sondage WHERE DateDebut <= CURDATE() ORDER BY DateDebut DESC LIMIT 1");
$sond = mysqli_fetch_array($rS);
$numS = $sond[0];
$r1 = mysqli_query($conn, "SELECT * FROM Participant WHERE Mail='$mail'");

if (mysqli_num_rows($r1) > 0) {
    $p = mysqli_fetch_array($r1);

    if ($p["Mdp"] != $mdp) {
        echo "Erreur d'authentification";
    } else {
        $idp = $p["IdParticipant"];

        $r2 = mysqli_query($conn, "SELECT * FROM Reponse WHERE NumS=$numS AND IdParticipant=$idp");

        $rep1 = substr($q1, 1, 1);
        $rep2 = substr($q2, 1, 1);
        $rep3 = substr($q3, 1, 1);

        if (mysqli_num_rows($r2) > 0) {
            mysqli_query($conn, "UPDATE Reponse SET Rep='$rep1' WHERE NumQ=1 AND NumS=$numS AND IdParticipant=$idp");
            mysqli_query($conn, "UPDATE Reponse SET Rep='$rep2' WHERE NumQ=2 AND NumS=$numS AND IdParticipant=$idp");
            mysqli_query($conn, "UPDATE Reponse SET Rep='$rep3' WHERE NumQ=3 AND NumS=$numS AND IdParticipant=$idp");

            echo "Mise à jour effectuée avec succès";
        } else {
            mysqli_query($conn, "INSERT INTO Reponse VALUES (1,$numS,$idp,'$rep1')");
            mysqli_query($conn, "INSERT INTO Reponse VALUES (2,$numS,$idp,'$rep2')");
            mysqli_query($conn, "INSERT INTO Reponse VALUES (3,$numS,$idp,'$rep3')");

            echo "Participation au sondage effectuée avec succès";
        }
    }
} else {
    mysqli_query($conn, "INSERT INTO Participant VALUES (NULL,'$mail','$mdp','$genre')");

    $r3 = mysqli_query($conn, "SELECT IdParticipant FROM Participant WHERE Mail='$mail' AND Mdp='$mdp'");
    $np = mysqli_fetch_array($r3);
    $idp = $np[0];

    $rep1 = substr($q1, 1, 1);
    $rep2 = substr($q2, 1, 1);
    $rep3 = substr($q3, 1, 1);

    mysqli_query($conn, "INSERT INTO Reponse VALUES (1,$numS,$idp,'$rep1')");
    mysqli_query($conn, "INSERT INTO Reponse VALUES (2,$numS,$idp,'$rep2')");
    mysqli_query($conn, "INSERT INTO Reponse VALUES (3,$numS,$idp,'$rep3')");

    echo "Inscription et participation au sondage effectuées avec succès";
}

mysqli_close($conn);
?>
